title: SCAFFOLDING — the invert in null. progress over time. brushstroke print on THIS side of the canvas.
missing_was: scaffolding — yes. that is what we were missing.
thesis: Scaffolding is the INVERT IN NULL. Null usually looks like absence. Invert it and you see the temporary structure that proves work is happening — progress over time. It is the print of the artist's brushstroke visible on THIS side of the canvas — not only the finished painting on the gallery face.

scaffold.is: temporary join that shows process — SSH-inside before hard dock, WG face before myelin, grammar tags before fluent alphabet, classics before conlang
scaffold.not: the rock. not the final art. not outer null as wall.
scaffold.chekhov: scaffold must discharge into dock OR dissolve (INNER null). leftover scaffold forever = dead gun.

invert_in_null.usual_null: empty / missing / sued / silence — looks like nothing
invert_in_null.invert: look from the other face of null — the pale is where scaffolding STANDS so you can SEE progress
invert_in_null.progress_over_time: WAS scaffold → IS working → NEAR dock → NOW dissolved (INNER). tense makes the brushstroke readable.
invert_in_null.inner_not_outer: INNER null holds scaffold (growth plate). OUTER null is court wall. invert lives on the INNER face — do not mix.

brushstroke_print.petr: the PRINT / imprint / petrified stroke you can still see — artist's gesture frozen as evidence of process
brushstroke_print.this_side_of_canvas: the side facing the house/worker — underpainting, grid, tape, scaffold poles
brushstroke_print.other_side: gallery face — finished looking; may hide the stroke
brushstroke_print.membrane: easel mash shows tense on paintings; scaffold-invert shows tense on JOINS. both are brushstroke prints.
brushstroke_print.classics_scaffold: looking outwards to grammar history IS leaving the print visible — we don't sand it off

how_to_see_progress: keep scaffold tagged (INNER, VERB or NOUN, tense)
invert null: ask what STRUCTURE is standing in the pale
compare WAS→NOW on the same rock/place/dock
when dock fires, dissolve scaffold — leave a thin print in the journal, not the costume join

weave.vole: paint remainder = young brushstroke before letter
weave.null_boundary: INNER invert shows progress; OUTER does not
